ideas.text: An AI that reads your company values deck and tells you which ones are aspirations and which ones are currently true.
A bot that counts how many approval layers are required for a $200 decision at a company that values 'trust.'
An app that detects when 'unlimited PTO' at your company averages fewer days than limited PTO did at your last job.
A tool that converts 'we're like a family' into its operational implications for calling out sick.
An AI that detects when the culture deck hasn't been updated since the company had 12 employees.
A bot that counts how many times the word 'authentic' appears in a document that is clearly not.
An app that detects when a company's stated values and a visible recent decision are pointing in opposite directions.
A tool that evaluates whether the 'best place to work' award required employees to fill out a survey or the award just happened.
An AI that translates 'we move fast' into the average time a decision takes at this company from proposal to approval.
A bot that detects when the culture deck is used in recruiting but never referenced internally.
An app that identifies which company values are referenced in performance reviews and which ones exist only in the lobby.
A tool that detects when 'we trust our employees' is followed by monitoring software installed on work laptops.
An AI that converts a company's values into a quiz and tests whether the leadership team passes it.
A bot that detects when 'fail fast' is being cited to justify a failure that took 18 months to become visible.
An app that counts how many times 'transparency' is mentioned in a company where the salary bands are still secret.
A tool that generates the version of the culture deck that reflects what employees actually experience.
An AI that detects when a company's diversity commitment hasn't resulted in a change to the leadership page in 3 years.
A bot that monitors how many culture initiatives are running simultaneously and whether any of them have metrics.
An app that detects when a values workshop produced no change and was immediately followed by another values workshop.
A tool that identifies which company value is most frequently violated in practice based on employee survey language.
An AI that converts 'we're customer-obsessed' into a test: how long does it take to reach a human when something breaks?
A bot that detects when a company's all-hands culture speech was almost word-for-word the same as last year's.
An app that tracks the gap between what a company says in its employer branding and what employees say in exit interviews.
A tool that detects when a culture initiative was launched to manage a PR problem rather than address an employee one.
An AI that translates 'we're mission-driven' into the specific trade-off between mission and compensation you're about to make.
A bot that detects when a company added 'inclusive' to its values the same week a discrimination complaint was filed.
An app that evaluates whether the 'flat hierarchy' your company describes matches its actual decision-making structure.
A tool that detects when a company's culture is described using the word 'vibes' by more than 40% of employees in surveys.
An AI that reads a company's values and checks whether any of them are legally or operationally constrained from being true.
A bot that monitors whether 'psychological safety' is mentioned more often in meetings than it is modeled in them.
An app that detects when a company posts about work-life balance and then sends a company-wide email at 7pm on a Friday.
A tool that converts the employer branding page into a Glassdoor rating prediction based on the promises made.
An AI that detects when a company's 'no jerks' policy is enforced differently depending on the jerk's seniority.
A bot that translates 'we're a learning organization' into when the company last changed something based on feedback.
An app that detects when a company's values redesign produced values that are nearly identical to the previous ones.
A tool that identifies how many culture-related initiatives were launched this year by a company that fired an HR team.
An AI that detects when 'we celebrate failure' is used by a company where nobody has been publicly rewarded for failing.
A bot that converts 'generous equity package' into the expected value under 3 realistic exit scenarios.
An app that detects when a company promotes values of 'ownership' but requires 3 approvals to send an external email.
A tool that identifies when the culture deck was written by a consultant who spent 2 days with leadership and left.
An AI that converts 'we believe in work-life integration' into what that means at 9pm on a Sunday.
A bot that detects when a company's wellness program costs less annually than one month of the CEO's total compensation.
An app that monitors whether 'bring your whole self to work' extends to people who are visibly unhappy about something.
A tool that detects when a company invests more in employer branding than in the employee experience being branded.
An AI that converts a culture deck into the set of behaviors that are actually rewarded in performance reviews.
A bot that detects when 'collaborative culture' means all decisions go through one person before moving forward.
An app that identifies which culture promises in the offer letter went undelivered and when the pattern started.
A tool that evaluates whether a company's 'zero tolerance' policy has ever resulted in a zero-tolerance outcome at a senior level.
An AI that detects when a company says 'we're building something special' and checks whether the tenure data agrees.
A bot that detects when the company's stated values are used to explain a layoff that they're also the reason for.
An app that generates the one honest sentence that should replace the first page of any company culture deck.
An AI that reads a startup's culture page and estimates how many of those things are still true after Series B.
A bot that detects when 'we're changing the world' is the company's excuse for not changing the comp structure.
An app that detects when a company's values include 'growth mindset' but performance reviews penalize mistakes.
A tool that generates the culture doc the company should have written based on what it actually rewards.
An AI that converts 'we're building the future' into a realistic description of what your day will look like in week 3.
A bot that detects when a culture score improved while headcount dropped and asks who was left to fill out the survey.
